from pathlib import Path
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/telegram-robot-leads/scripts')

]:
 try:print(label+'_COUNT',operation())
 except Exception as e:print(label+'_READ_STATUS',type(e).__name__)

 print('OWNED_CHANNEL_PROMOTION_ENABLED',model.get('owned_channel_promotion',False))
except Exception as e:print('VOLUNTARY_MODEL_READ_STATUS',type(e).__name__)

 state=load_state(Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/operation-state.json'))
 for name in ('pending_member_actions','pending_join_requests','approved_user_ids_done','approved_join_requests_done'):
